newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Play suspended in Australian PGA due to wind.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Play suspended in Australian PGA due to wind.

text.p: Play has been suspended during the first round of the Australian PGA championship due to strong winds at the New South Wales Golf Club, tournament officials said on Thursday.
Tournament supervisor Chris Nightingale told reporters play had been suspended because several holes, including the 15th and 17th, had become unplayable.
"That is due entirely to the strength of the wind," Nightingale said.
"It makes it difficult if not impossible to keep balls on the greens," he said.
